headline: AI Selloff Hits Nvidia, AMD, Anthropic
detail: This confirms a broad downturn in AI and chip stocks, which are the core of your portfolio. The weakness in major players like Nvidia and AMD suggests continued pressure on your highly concentrated tech/chip holdings, especially leveraged ones.
rec: Consider trimming leveraged chip/AI positions like SOXL (-79.84%) and SMH (-29.68%) to reduce exposure. A tactical long on SOXS (entry 61.27-60.69, stop 59.51) could hedge against further semiconductor declines.

headline: SoftBank's Worst Day Amid AI Sell-off
detail: This reinforces the global nature of the AI tech sell-off, extending beyond US markets to Asian tech. It signals that the current weakness isn't isolated, suggesting a broader negative sentiment that will continue to weigh on your tech-heavy portfolio.
rec: Given the widespread tech weakness, review all leveraged tech holdings, particularly PLTU (-37.72%) and MUU (-64.05%), for potential trims to protect capital.

headline: S&P 500 Losing Streak Analysis
detail: The S&P 500's extended losing streak indicates broader market weakness, which will drag down even healthy tech names. This general market pressure adds to the specific tech sector headwinds, making it harder for your SPY and QQQ positions to recover.
rec: No direct trade action from this headline alone, but it underscores the need to closely monitor your SPY (-2.52%) and QQQ (-9.74%) positions for further downside.
